BW-BENCH-EQ70-30.name: 70/30 US Large/Small all-equity blend (70% IWB + 30% IWM)
BW-BENCH-EQ70-30.methodology: Fixed-weight all-equity blend: 70% iShares Russell 1000 ETF (IWB) + 30% iShares Russell 2000 ETF (IWM). Each component's in-ERM3 weight vector is renormalized to 1, scaled by its notional weight, and the two are summed over the union of symbols at each teo the components share. Illustrative large/small split (IWB ∪ IWM ≈ Russell 3000).
BW-BENCH-EQ70-30.rebalance_schedule: Notional weights fixed at 70/30; the component weight vectors drift with the underlying ETF holdings (no rebalancing of the blend itself in v1).

BW-BENCH-SPY.name: S&P 500 (proxy: SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust SPY from 2024; iShares Core S&P 500 ETF IVV before)
BW-BENCH-SPY.methodology: Float-adjusted market-cap-weighted S&P 500 constituents. From 2024-01-02 the surface is SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY)'s published daily holdings; before that it is iShares Core S&P 500 ETF (IVV)'s holdings (sponsor CSV where cached, N-PORT / N-Q month-end anchors otherwise). At each teo the in-ERM3 holdings are renormalized to weights summing to 1 (cash / non-ERM3 lines dropped, as for any portfolio surface).
BW-BENCH-SPY.rebalance_schedule: S&P 500 reconstitution is quarterly (effective the 3rd Friday of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec) plus ad-hoc index changes; from 2024 the surface tracks SPY's daily-published holdings (daily teos); before 2024 it is month-end IVV anchors.
BW-BENCH-SPY.notes: Spliced proxy (IVV before 2024-01-02, SPY from then on). On 2026-05-11/12, the only days both sponsor files are cached, the two in-ERM3 weight vectors have 495 names each, 490 in common, L1 distance 0.017; the 5+5 differences are identifier-resolution misses (SPY rows resolve by CUSIP, IVV rows by ticker), not index differences.
